summary: A value turned on a round dial: drag up or down, scroll, or use the arrow keys, and double-click to put it back.

props.name: label
props.description: The name above the knob, which also names it to screen readers.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value at the start. A double-click returns to it, or to the first `value`.

props.name: centered
props.description: Fills the arc from the top, for a value with a middle, such as balance.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Draws a tick at each step, for a knob with a few settings.

props.name: unit
props.description: Text after the value, such as `%`.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Writes the value under the knob, and reads it to screen readers.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the value with a form under this name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks turning and dims the knob.

props.name: animated
props.description: A step from the keyboard or the wheel turning over 150ms, and the value rolling. Reduced motion turns both off.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
